title: Existing installations.
officialText:
Except as otherwise specifically provided, plumbing systems lawfully in existence at the time of the
adoption or a subsequent amendment of this code shall be permitted to have their use and maintenance continued if the use,
maintenance or repair is in accordance with the original design and no hazard to life, health or property is created by such plumbing
system.
